article.story: LEWISBURG, Pa. -- — Tim Ibukunoluwa’s 34 points led Siena over Bucknell 93-87 on Saturday. Ibukunoluwa added 15 rebounds and six assists for the Saints (4-2). Brendan Coyle scored 15 points while shot 2 for 4 from beyond the arc and 9 of 9 from the free-throw line, and added six rebounds. Reid Ducharme shot 3 for 8 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 6 of 7 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points. Jayden Williams led the Bison (1-5) in scoring, finishing with 19 points and seven assists. Aleksander Pachucki added 15 points and six rebounds for Bucknell.
